messages:
Emily S: Customer reported invoice stuck 'on hold' when they attach a PO and request reverse-charge. They say VIES rejects the VAT ID even though it's valid in their national registry. Screenshot: https://support.redwood.example/cases/INC-4987/screenshot.png
Sanjay K: Can you paste the VAT ID and the PO number? I want to reproduce with our validation service.
Emily S: VAT ID: GB999999973 (company HQ) — but customer provided a branch ID: XI123456789 (Northern Ireland branch). PO: PO-789234. They said VIES returns a timeout, then `VAT_UNKNOWN`. billing-bot posted: Invoice 00012345 put on hold: tax verification failed (VIES response: 504 Gateway Timeout).
Olga F: NI/GB prefixes are messy with cross-border checks. VIES sometimes returns unknown for XI prefixes. Repro steps I ran: 1) call /v1/tax/validate with XI123456789 -> 502 after 10s. 2) fallback to national registry API -> returns active.
Sanjay K: Logs from validation service (sanitized):
```
[2024-04-12T14:12:05Z] POST /tax/validate {"vat_id":"XI123456789","country":"GB"}
[2024-04-12T14:12:15Z] VIES timeout -> 504
[2024-04-12T14:12:15Z] Fallback -> national-registry GET /companies?vat=XI123456789 -> 200 OK {"status":"active"}
```
Emily S: Customer insists the invoice must be net and show reverse charge because their PO requires intra-UK branch billing rules. They uploaded a resale certificate PDF but billing queue still shows 'tax check pending'.
Mateo (Finance): Dropping in — we cannot mark reverse-charge without verification from a recognized source. If VIES says unknown we need either: 1) national registry proof + legal entity doc, or 2) manual override from Finance with a compliance note. Please attach the certificate and the branch incorporation doc.
Emily S: Attached resale_cert.pdf and branch_doc.pdf to the case. Also customer provided a gov link: https://gov.example/companies/XI123456789 which returns 200.
Sanjay K: Suggestion: add special-casing for XI prefix in our tax pipeline: when VIES times out or returns unknown for XI, auto-fallback and mark 'validated-by-national-registry' instead of leaving invoice on hold. I'll open an infra ticket.
Olga F: Agreed. For immediate unblock: @Mateo (Finance) can you do a one-off manual clearance for Invoice 00012345? We'll note audit trail: fallback verification passed and customer provided gov landing page + resale cert.
Mateo (Finance): I can clear this after I confirm the docs. Emily, please DM me the case link and I'll sign off. I will also request the accounting team to add a policy note for NI branches. :white_check_mark:
Emily S: Sent DM with link. Marking thread for escalation to billing-policy and eng-ml (tax pipeline) to address XI handling. Closing loop: customer update will be sent once manual clearance is done. :thumbsup:
